proposals.before: In the ninth year of Huitong (942) he surrendered to Liao together with Du Chongwei.
proposals.after: In the ninth year of Huitong (946) he surrendered to Liao together with Du Chongwei.
proposals.reason: Huitong 1 is AD 938, so Huitong 9 is AD 946, not 942.

proposals.before: Early in the Baoning era he entered palace service as a duty officer and was repeatedly posted to Xuju.
proposals.after: Early in the Baoning era he entered palace service as a duty officer and was repeatedly assigned to demanding posts.
proposals.reason: Chinese 累任珝劇 is likely 累任劇 (repeatedly held demanding/critical posts); rendering 珝劇 as the place-name Xuju is unsupported.

proposals.before: At the beginning of Baoning he became a palace duty officer and was repeatedly assigned to Xuju.
proposals.after: At the beginning of Baoning he became a palace duty officer and was repeatedly assigned to demanding posts.
proposals.reason: Same as idiomatic: 珝劇 should not be read as a place name Xuju.

decisions.reason: 會同元年 is AD 938, so 會同九年 is AD 946; the parenthetical (942) is a conversion error, and the proposed (946) matches the Chinese year and the following entry of Taizong into Bian.
累任珝劇 is a corrupt form of 累任艱劇 (‘repeatedly held arduous/demanding posts’); external witnesses read 艰剧 and do not support a place-name Xuju.
The same 累任珝劇 corruption should be read as 累任艱劇, so ‘demanding posts’ is correct and ‘Xuju’ as a posting place is unsupported.
